verdict.rationale: Submodule management is a fair question for a mobile GitHub/code client, since iOS git clients exist, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions cloning, updating, or managing submodules. A hands-on community comment says the app 'doesn't really seem to be a git client', and the docs cover only PR review, Copilot tasks, code search and browsing.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can clone, update, and manage Git submodules within a repository
